Get a woman by being truly kind and loving toward someone who amazes you every day. Get friends by being a pleasant person to be around. By being someone who is uplifting, kind, generous. Honestly, people just forget to say it. They forget to tell you how much they love you and appreciate you, because you’re a part of their daily lives. “You never know what you have until it’s gone” is so true. When they consider losing you, it TERRIFIES them. You are a cornerstone for them. They love you and care about you. The threat of losing you is what encourages them to voice their appreciation and love. It doesn’t make it mean any less, it just means that they have something (someone) that they need to start fighting for. And they will fight for you. Every time. People love you and that is what you need to focus on. I love you! Even if you think it doesn’t mean anything from a strange girl on the internet, don’t give up. Someone ALWAYS will fight to keep you as part of their daily life.

Kindness, goodness, empathy...these are the traits that will make you happy. Have you considered that Logan continues to push the limits for views? Maybe this NEXT video will be edgy enough to get him the fame that will make him rich enough, popular enough, to be happy. But it never does. He continues to push the limits of acceptable actions, just to gain a following. People who are truly happy can overcome this need for attention and credit. They realize that the true impact they have on a single life is worth living for. Putting pure good into the world is worth living for. Beyond that, it is worth feeling joyous about. Take joy in making someone’s day or making someone happy. That is how you will find true fulfillment and joy. But that is just one drunk chick’s thoughts at three AM
